main_text.l: כְּסַל m. Stoliditas, Stultitia, Psal.49.14. Ilia, Job.15.27. Spes,Fiducia,Exspectatio: Aff. כִּסְלִי Spes sua, Job.8.14. Plural. כְּסָלִים Ilia, Levit.3.4. Aff. כְּסָלַי Ilia mea, Psal.38.8.
כִּסְלָתְךָ f. Stultitia, Fatuitas: Spes. Aff. כִּסְלָתְךָ Spes tua, Job.4.6.
* כִּסְלֵו m. Kislev, mensis noni nomen, incipiens à novilunio Novembris nostri, Zach.7.1.
כָּסַם Totondit: Infinit.&Futur. יִכְסֹם יִכְסֹם Tondendo tondento, Ezech.44.20.
כִּסְמֶת f. Zea, frumenti genus, quod vulgò Spelta dicitur, Exod.9.32. Plural masc. וְכִסְּמִים Et speltas, Ezech.4.9. à sing. כֻּסֶּם.
כָּסַס Numeravit, Supputavit: In summam redegit: Futur. תִּכְסְּמוּ Numerabit, Exod.12.4.

כְּסָּה m. Feria stativa, Tempus statum, quod in Numeratum anni diem semper recurrit, Proverb.7.20. Psal.81.8. Rabbini vocant מוֹעֵד כָּסוּא Solennitate fixam: Aben Esra Noviluinium interpretatur, à כָּסָא Tegere, quòd tunc Luna Sole Tegitur.
מִכְסָּם m. Numerus, Portio numerata, Summa, Num.31.28. Aff. וּמִכְסָּם Et portio eorum, v.40.
מִכְסָּה f. Summa, Numeratū: Constr. אֶת־מִכְסַּת Summam, Lev.27.23. כְּמִכְסַּת Secundum numerum, Exod.12.4. Leniter sine Dagesch, pro מִכְסָּה forma מִגְלָה.

כָּסַף Appetivit, Expetivit: Futur. יִכְסַף Appetet, Psalm.17.12. תִּכְסַף Expetes, Job.14.15. Niphal, נִכְסַף Desiderio affici vel teneri: Infin.&Praet. נִכְסָף נִכְסְפָּתְךָ Desiderando desiderio tenebaris, Genes.31.30. נִכְסַף Desiderio afficitur, Psalm.84.3, Particip. נִכְסָף Affecta desiderio, Soph.2.1.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are approximate in several entries, especially the forms in the Niphal and Pual lines and the Aben Esra gloss; the Hebrew letters themselves are copied as seen. Large letters opening entries (כסם, כסף) are set in the scan as enlarged initial headwords and are joined to their entries. Where the scan is faint (plural forms in the כסלי and כסמים entries, and the Numerabit form), readings are the most likely ones and may need checking. The catchword is read as בסף.
